```yaml
name: Update MS Learn Dates

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v2
        with:
          version: '7.4'

      - name: Setup Azure CLI
        uses: azure/setup-azure-cli@v1

      - name: Install Bicep CLI
        run: az bicep install

      - name: Build all Bicep templates
        run: |
          find . -name '*.bicep' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -print0 | \
          xargs -0 -I {} sh -c 'echo "Building {}"; az bicep build --file "{}"'

      - name: Run Build-Toolkit
        run: pwsh -File Build-Toolkit.ps1

      - name: Run Package-Toolkit
        run: pwsh -File Package-Toolkit.ps1

      - name: Verify metadata.bicep files copied to release output
        run: |
          if ! find ./release -name 'metadata.bicep' | grep -q .; then
            echo "metadata.bicep files not found in release output"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Deploy Hub (only on main branch)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: azure/login@v1
        with:
          creds: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CREDENTIALS }}

      - name: Deploy Hub template
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: |
          az deployment sub create \
            --location eastus \
            --template-file ./hub/main.bicep \
            --parameters @./hub/parameters.json
```

yaml:
name: Update MS Learn Dates

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v2
        with:
          version: '7.4'

      - name: Setup Azure CLI
        uses: azure/setup-azure-cli@v1

      - name: Install Bicep CLI
        run: az bicep install

      - name: Build all Bicep templates
        run: |
          find . -name '*.bicep' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -print0 | \
          xargs -0 -I {} sh -c 'echo "Building {}"; az bicep build --file "{}"'

      - name: Run Build-Toolkit
        run: pwsh -File Build-Toolkit.ps1

      - name: Run Package-Toolkit
        run: pwsh -File Package-Toolkit.ps1

      - name: Verify metadata.bicep files copied to release output
        run: |
          if ! find ./release -name 'metadata.bicep' | grep -q .; then
            echo "metadata.bicep files not found in release output"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Deploy Hub (only on main branch)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: azure/login@v1
        with:
          creds: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CREDENTIALS }}

      - name: Deploy Hub template
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: |
          az deployment sub create \
            --location eastus \
            --template-file ./hub/main.bicep \
            --parameters @./hub/parameters.json
